# 2 Baruch Chapter 7 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Fall of Jerusalem

---

**7:1** And I Baruch and-Jeremiah [went], and-the-city was-delivered-into-the-hands-of-the-enemy.

**7:2** And Jeremiah the-prophet was-given-leave to-go-with-the-captives; but-I-Baruch remained-there.

---

*EMET notes: Chapter 7 is a pivot. Baruch remains at the ruins while Jeremiah accompanies the captives (cf. Jer 40). This separation sets up the remainder of the book. The extreme brevity (2 verses) marks it as a transitional unit.*
